name: Harold Spencer
original_name: ハロルド・スペンサー
source:
A noble of the city of Tenbrige. Well known as a hedonist and philanthropist. Unlike most nobles, he cares very little about the concept of honor.

Olivia's fiancé.

[From [url=https://laplacian.jp/yonagi/en]Laplacian[/url]]
